N1-altered-value.what: the request and the attempt carry a specification (pull_number 4522) that differs from the one the person was shown and approved (4521); the action record's args_hash is the executed one

N2-reused-single-use-approval.what: a second request (q2), recheck, attempt and result rest on approval o1, whose request_limit is 1

N3-approver-outside-trust-policy.what: the approval is a valid Ed25519 signature by a key (someone-else-key-1) that the verifier's trust policy does not list

N3b-approver-key-in-wrong-role.what: the same signature, the key listed in the policy but in role organisation: an organisation's key cannot approve as a person

N4-policy-digest-mismatch.what: the policy held allows a day where the signed one allowed 900 s: its digest is not the specification's policy_version

policy_checks.policy_digest: failed: the policy held is not the one the specification names

N5-policy-not-held.what: the verifier holds no copy of the issuer's policy: what it alone can show is not checked, never verified

policy_checks.policy_digest: not_checked: the policy is not held
policy_checks.approval_age: not_checked: the policy is not held
policy_checks.designated_approver: not_checked: the policy is not held

N6-attempt-after-policy-limit.what: the attempt is 28 minutes after the approval: past the signed policy's 900 s and past valid_until; the executor's recheck recorded 'authorised' anyway

policy_checks.approval_age: failed: attempt 1680 s after the approval, the policy allows 900

N7-policy-relabelled-in-specification.what: the issuer rewrites the attachment so that the specification names another policy; the person's signature still covers the original digests

N7b-authority-ref-relabelled.what: authority_ref changed after signing: the person's signature stays verified, by design; authority_ref is the issuer's statement and only policy_version is under the signature
